key_insight: Homogeneous WC9Co9Cr powder and spray method jointly control coating density, carbide distribution, hardness, and friction performance.
engineering_relevance: Choosing detonation spraying or HVOF enables tuning WC9Co9Cr coatings for either higher hardness or lower-friction, durable wear protection in loaded machine parts.
method: Compared WC9Co9Cr cermet coatings made by detonation spraying and HVOF.
Characterized powder morphology, coating microstructure, and phase composition using SEM and EDS.
Evaluated mechanical/tribological performance via microhardness and friction coefficient measurements.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a harder DS coating (average microhardness 1449 HV) and an HVOF coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143).
watch_item: Performance depends strongly on powder quality and process parameters, so the reported optimum may not transfer directly to other feedstocks or spray setups.
paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
